## Pointcuts

Examples:

- `execution(* com.example.demo.service.*.*(..))`
- `@annotation(com.example.demo.Logged)`

Be precise — too wide slows and surprises.

## Proxy types

| Kind | Used when |
|------|-----------|
| JDK dynamic proxy | Bean implements interface; proxy implements interface |
| CGLIB subclass | Concrete class proxy (common with Spring Boot) |

**Self-invocation problem:** `this.method()` inside the same class bypasses the proxy → advice may not run. Call through injected bean instead.

## Practice

Prove self-invocation skips advice; then fix by moving call to another bean.
